notes: The whole shape of a round, as data. The engine walks this list and does not
know what a 'discussion' is — it knows a phase has a duration, a sky, a set of
capabilities it unlocks, and what comes next. Reordering the round, adding a
phase, or giving one a different clock is an edit to this file.
`sky.from`/`sky.to` name stops in data/sky.json. The theme crossfades between
them across the phase's duration, so the village really does go night → dawn →
noon → dusk → night while you play, and the phase you are in is legible from
the colour of the room before you read a word of it.

phases.name: Lobby
phases.description: Before anything. The host sets the roster and the roles.

phases.name: Your role
phases.description: Everyone reads their own card at the same time. No passing anything around.

phases.name: Night
phases.description: The village is asleep and everyone moves at once. First knock, first served.

phases.name: Dawn
phases.description: What the village finds, and who found it.

phases.name: Discussion
phases.description: Five minutes of daylight to work out who is lying.

phases.name: Voting
phases.description: Votes are cast openly and can be changed until the clock runs out.

phases.name: Verdict
phases.description: The rope, or the reprieve. Then the sun goes down again.

phases.name: Game over
phases.description: Every role revealed, every night replayed.

firstRound.notes: The first night is a full night; immunity is a room setting, not a phase change.

phaseDurations.label: Phase timers
phaseDurations.description: Seconds each phase runs. Null means it waits for the host.
